utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along nicely—did they still need volunteers for pickups?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, they still could use a few more hands for pickups. I can help Saturday morning if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That still works great—Saturday morning should help a lot. I’ll spread the word and see if anyone else can pitch in for pickups.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in—just send me the time and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the time and a quick list of what to bring soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Leo — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, it’s still happening, but I’m double-checking the timing and drop-off details first so nothing gets messy.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—just let me know once the timing and drop-off are confirmed, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I should probably check what still needs fixing and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with that — I’ve been keeping track of supplies, so let’s see what’s still missing and what’s ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a huge help. I’ll start with the list and see if I can round up anything we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs repairing and when the drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s the usual stuff—maybe the loose fence and that squeaky gate? And I’m pretty sure the drive is this weekend, but I should double-check.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’d like to confirm the exact repairs and the day before I do anything. If you check, let me know and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need me to grab for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — if you can grab a Phillips screwdriver, some zip ties, and a roll of duct tape, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — Phillips screwdriver, zip ties, and duct tape. I’ll head over and grab them now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Gus. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — we could still use a drill, a ladder, and someone to help sort the donated parts. If you’ve got time, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring my drill and help sort the donated parts. I may also be able to lend a ladder if you still need one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where things are going for the repair drive—just tell me the drop-off spot and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let’s use the school parking lot by the gym for drop-offs. I’ll send you the time and any updates as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve noted the school parking lot by the gym as the drop-off spot. Send me the time when you have it, and I’ll keep track of any updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up nicely—people have been dropping things off all morning. If you’re heading over, I can point you to the best spot to leave donations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh nice, I’m glad to hear it! I’ll head over soon—thanks for pointing me to the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—just go to the community center side entrance, and there’s a table set up right by the blue awning. I’ll be around if you need a hand!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the main repair you want help with?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the loose kitchen tap—it’s been dripping for a while.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—do you need help replacing the tap, or just tightening it up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you passing it along. I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and let people know the time, place, and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’ve got the repair drive organized and ready to go. I can share the volunteer list and the pickup plan whenever you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’m ready when you are—please send the volunteer list and pickup plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send over the volunteer list and the pickup plan right away, so we can keep everything moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up nicely — people have been dropping off tools and snacks all morning. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Tess. Please tell me what’s still needed so I can plan what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve heard they still need duct tape, a couple of screwdrivers, and some extra extension cords. If you can bring any of that, it’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m a bit late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane — I’m just getting it rolling and repeating the plan to folks: drop off repairs by the curb, and we’ll sort them in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help sort once I’m there. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Rey. I’m still sorting out exactly what’s needed, but I may ask you for help soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll skim the details and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive details and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Appreciate it — just ping me if there’s a specific task you want me to take on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana — I’m glad you’re here. I think the repair drive’s a great chance to get everyone pitching in together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds great, Jules — what exactly needs fixing, and what time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly small stuff: loose shelves, squeaky doors, and a few bikes that need tune-ups. We’re starting at 10, and I can point you to the right table when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — we’re gathering tools, a few volunteers, and any broken items folks want help fixing. If you’re free, I’d love for you to bring a drill or just come lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can bring my drill and I’ll swing by to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting started soon—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly just hands and a few basics—if you’ve got a drill, screwdriver set, or even a step ladder, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can bring my screwdriver set and the step ladder. Just tell me where and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a screwdriver set and some duct tape? If you can, swing by around 3 and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and duct tape and I’ll stop by around 3.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense — I’m still sorting the timing, but I can get you the drop-off spot and schedule next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot. Once you have the drop-off spot and schedule, I can see what fits.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive — you should definitely come by! If you want, I can swing you the details and time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, send me the details and time — I’ll check what supplies I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it starts at 10 AM on Saturday at the community shed, and we could use screwdrivers, gloves, and any spare paint you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off, so just let me know what time the repair drive needs us.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Faye—that’d be a huge help. I’ll check the repair drive time and let you know as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course—once you have the time, send it over and I’ll work it around school runs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m setting up the repair drive list now, and I’d love your help keeping track of what each neighbor needs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I can help keep track. Just tell me what folks need and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — could you start with Mrs. Alvarez on Pine, who needs a leaky kitchen faucet fixed, and Mr. Kim on Oak, whose porch light is out?
